slides: Impossible is just what cowards call it when they quit
For a full year they said it was impossible
If you accepted what someone said was impossible
And you stopped reaching for it
And you told yourself the story that you tried
You built your entire life on a lie
You have today to refuse it Follow for the ones who don't quit
caption:
The word impossible stops most men. But the discipline to refuse it is the self improvement that changes everything you do next.

For a full year Ford's engineers told him it couldn't be done. They believed it. They said impossible.

Then they tried a different way.

The moment you accept impossible is real, you've lost. The moment you refuse it, you move.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
